description: Organization does not direct, monitor, and review outsourced system development activities. This signal indicates that third-party, contractor, or vendor-led development work lacks appropriate oversight, security requirements, code review, testing verification, or contractual security obligations.
applicability: Applicable to all outsourced development activities including offshore development, contractor engagements, managed service providers, software development agencies, open-source contributions, and any external development resources. Covers custom software development, system integration, and code modifications performed by external parties.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of vendor contracts, service agreements, development oversight procedures, code review processes, security requirements documentation, acceptance testing procedures, and vendor management policies. May also be identified through absence of security clauses in development contracts or lack of code validation processes.
